02Who We Are

A PTFE Manufacturer Built on Precision

SK Polymers manufactures and supplies PTFE & Teflon products for sealing, insulation, sliding and corrosion-resistant applications. We work from Babosa Industrial Park on the Kalyan–Bhiwandi Bypass in Maharashtra, supplying buyers in Bhiwandi, Thane and Mumbai and dispatching across India.

  • Virgin & Filled Grades Virgin PTFE plus glass, carbon, bronze and graphite-filled grades
  • Custom CNC Machining Components machined to your drawing, sample or CAD file
  • Pan-India Delivery Dispatch across India in secure industrial packing
  • Grade Selection Support Help choosing the right PTFE grade and product form

07Common Questions

Frequently Asked

Can’t find what you need? Our team answers material and machining questions directly — or read our PTFE technical guides.

Ask a Question

PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene), widely known by the trade name Teflon™, is a fluoropolymer with outstanding chemical resistance, a typical service range of about −200 °C to +260 °C and one of the lowest coefficients of friction of any solid. That combination makes it a standard material for gaskets, seals, bushes, linings and insulation. More in our PTFE properties guide.

Yes. We cut sheets, rods and tubes to size and CNC-machine components to your drawing, sample or CAD file. See custom PTFE machining.

Virgin PTFE plus glass-filled, carbon-filled, bronze-filled and graphite-filled grades. Each improves wear, creep or thermal conductivity in a different way — see virgin vs filled PTFE, or tell us the application and we will recommend one.

We are at Babosa Industrial Park, Kalyan–Bhiwandi Bypass, Maharashtra, and supply customers in Bhiwandi, Thane, Mumbai and across India through logistics partners. Export enquiries are welcome. Delivery time is confirmed with each quotation.

The product and grade (or your operating conditions), dimensions or a drawing, quantity, and the application — media, temperature and pressure help us recommend the right material and quote accurately.
